    public static void main(String[] args) {

        String s = in.nextLine();
        in.close();

        AtomicInteger res = new AtomicInteger(0);
        if (s != null && s.length() > 1) {
            int n = s.length();
            AtomicInteger start = new AtomicInteger(0);

                    if (((i - start.get()) & 1) == 0) {

                    start.set(i);
